Definition
[Lower semicontinuous] 1. ch9:9.6.1-def-2\group Convex Analysis We say $I : H \to (-\infty , +\infty ]$ is lower semicontinuous if \[ \begin{cases} u_k \to u \text{ in } H \text{ implies} \\ I[u] \le \liminf _{k \to \infty } I[u_k]. \end{cases} \]
